verdict.rationale: Segment's own docs show Audiences built from events, traits and computed traits can be synced to hundreds of destinations, and Engage is described as 'powered by real-time data'. That establishes audience activation. However, nothing documents continuous sync cadence or near-real-time membership entry and exit, and no ad-platform destination is named. Missing for 10: documented real-time or streaming audience computation with entry/exit events, explicit ad-platform audience destinations (e.g. Facebook/Google Ads), sync latency/cadence details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
